listing.name: Power Instinct Matrimelee (Neo Geo) / Matrimelee-Recomp (omegakatana92)
listing.summary: Native static recompilation of Power Instinct Matrimelee (Neo Geo, 2003) for Windows x64 and Steam Deck. Motorola 68000 translated to C with NeoGeoRecomp; no emulator frontend. No ROMs or BIOS included.
